units.does: Sets isPurging, then in a Task awaits runPurge (which keeps the purge's Report, or the refusal while a recording is under way or a reading is waiting to be accepted, or after a recording started during the iCloud deletion), clears isPurging and clears the typed confirmation phrase so a rerun (the iCloud-failure retry) needs the phrase typed again.
units.entry: Called from confirmation dialog destructive button

units.does: Awaits DataPurgeService.purgeAllUserData(archive, rawBackup, cloudSync, settingsManager, stores: dependencies.purgeStores — the stores of the view's composition-root container) — refused while a recording is under way or a reading is waiting to be accepted, otherwise remote CloudKit zone deletion then local container/defaults/keychain wipe. On success stores the Report and clears refusal; on refusal stores the refusal's localized description and keeps the earlier report (before any deletion nothing was deleted; a recording that started during the iCloud deletion leaves the device unwiped, which the refusal's text says).
